subject: diplomatic-appointments-lqa
note: 7A, 2 October 2026, against the first reading print (Senate) of 7 September 2026, following LQA-CATEGORIES.md. Each run covered all four Parts in coverage.json; the Acts Interpretation Act provisions bearing on each Part (ss 2G, 2M, 3, 13, 15AB, 19, 33(3), 33(4), 33A, 36) were read first. The installed l4 has no 'verify' command, so step 1 of the L procedure (l4 verify) could not be run: l4 check was run over every module (all clean) and the combinations were enumerated by hand and through cases.l4. The console checker was run over the scheme ([]). The 25 ENCODING-NOTES.md entries and the 2A leads were each taken as leads and probed; where an entry or lead became a finding, its found_by is as it was noticed.

runs.note: Every s 6 term and every term borrowed from other Acts (MOP(S) Act staff categories, 'registered political party', 'Head of Mission') checked against each use. Undefined operative terms ('officer or employee' of a party; 'term of the appointment') are recorded under U-17 and T-19, whose primary category is U and T. 'Selection Committee' (s 12(2)) and 'designated diplomatic office' (s 7) fit every use.

All 34 reference-register entries checked: every internal cross-reference (ss 9(4), 10(6), 12(6)(b), (c), 13(1), 14(7), 8(2)(c)) exists and is the provision meant. Encoded targets (AIA time, MOP(S) Act, PSA s 39) called with the citing provision's facts: the MOP(S) Act mismatch is U-16; PSA s 39 is I-26. Anaphora: 'that House' (s 9(5)) is R-21; 'the person' in s 9(1)-(3) and 'the candidate' in s 10(2)(d), (3)(a) bind uniquely; 'the chargé d'affaires' is tagged in s 11(1).

l4 verify is not available in the installed l4 (see note). The decisions 'may this person be appointed', 'is this a recommendation', 'must this be terminated' enumerated over their conditions. Console checker: no conferred fact without an act.

Periods: s 2 (day after assent), s 8 (10 years), s 9(5) (5 sitting days), s 10(1) (7 days), s 10(3) (2 months), s 15 (12 months). Tested at month ends, 29 February and boundary days in cases.l4. FORK-05 (whether the day of establishment is one of the 7 days) and FORK-13 (whether a sitting on the day of appointment counts) were judged not consequential: no consequence follows from a late list or a late statement on the reading taken of FORK-16, so they stay forks and are not findings. The 10-year question is U-10; the stall when the 2 months are missed is L-04.

All 16 forks taken in turn. Consequential and recorded as U: FORK-01, -02, -03, -04, -06, -07 (answered), -08, -11, -15, -16. Recorded under another primary category: FORK-09 (X-01), FORK-10 (X-02), FORK-14 (X-24). Not consequential, so not findings: FORK-05, FORK-12, FORK-13 (they decide only the timing or existence of duties that carry no consequence).

Powers: s 7(2)/s 16 rules (within power; s 16(2) limits checked), s 12(1), (4) establishment and membership, s 9(3)(c)(i) satisfaction (the Minister named, as DD 3.4 Part 1 wants), the unnamed appointing, terminating and acting powers (P-03), revocation under AIA s 33(3) (P-05), and options never closed (P-27).

Every 'must' paired with its consequence. The Bill creates no offence (and s 16(2)(a) forbids rules creating one). The unpaired duties (ss 9(4)-(5), 10(1)-(3), 12(5)) are recorded as U-25 (E secondary), because whether s 14(1) attaches s 14(3) to them is FORK-16; the unnamed holder of the s 14(3), (6) duty is P-03 (E secondary). No E-primary candidate.

The Bill makes no amending instruction. Checked for missed consequential amendments (Public Service Act s 39; MOP(S) Act; Diplomatic and Consular Missions Act) and for transitional cover: s 15 deals with appointments made before commencement and with terms starting in the first 12 months (its own problems are T-19 and U-20). Nothing found.

Citing and cited provisions run together: s 14(2) with PSA s 39 (I-26); s 8(2)(b) with MOP(S) Act ss 3, 3AA, 4, 11 (U-16); s 8(2)(d) with Commonwealth Electoral Act s 4(1) (U-17); ss 9 and 11 against each other (L-18). Rules under s 16 cannot override the Act (Legislation Act s 13(1)(c)).

Every EM clause note (paras 1-36) set against its clause; s 3 (simplified outline), all headings and the notes to s 2(1) and s 10(7) set against the operative words. The second reading speech: Senator Payman sought leave to continue her remarks and the debate was adjourned (Senate Hansard, 7 September 2026, p. 60), so there is no speech to compare. EM paras 3 (repeats the s 15 slip, F-15), 12 (D-11), 23 and 33 (support readings taken) noted. The EM's own paragraph numbering skips 4 (the clause 3 note is unnumbered); that is a defect in the EM, not the Bill, and is not recorded as a finding.

Every duty checked for what compliance needs in the world: the bodies, registers and offices exist (DFAT, the Register of Political Parties, each House). Simulation at defaults (seeds 1-6, 365 days) shows Committees stalling (L-04, W secondary) but no duty impossible as such. Nothing W-primary demonstrated.

Read once for form; numbering of Parts, Divisions, sections, subsections and paragraphs checked mechanically (s 7(1)(a)-(o) uses 'i' and 'l' as DD 1.7 para 7 requires). The order of s 6 is S-13 (F secondary).

Against the pinned OPC Drafting Manual (edition 3.2), Plain English Manual, Reducing Complexity guide and Drafting Directions 1.3, 1.3A, 1.5, 1.7, 2.1, 2.2 and 3.4. Paragraph numbers for the Drafting Directions were taken from the numbered paragraphs of the pinned Word files (the text conversions drop the numbers). Checked and clean: commencement table form (DD 1.3), definitions section heading and signposts (DD 1.5 paras 5-7, 13), no 'unless the contrary intention appears' (DD 1.5 Part 3), no 'shall' (PEM para 83), Arabic Part numbers and full lettering (DD 1.7 paras 2, 7), 'Simplified outline of this Act' heading and location (DD 1.3A paras 38-40). The outline's conflicts with ss 9 and 14 (DD 1.3A para 30) are recorded under X-01 (S secondary). The three 'To avoid doubt' provisions (ss 10(7), 11(3), 16(2)) were set against Reducing Complexity para 113, which discourages unnecessary provisions but sets no rule; not recorded.
